handbook.what: One quiet line totalling your whole teaching load — how many students you have across every class, how many hours they have practised between them, and how many sessions have been run. It is a record of what has happened, never a target.
handbook.where: Underneath your classes on the schools dashboard.
how: Open the schools dashboard and scroll past your classes.
**Students** counts every pupil in every class you teach, each person once.
**Hours practised** is real practice time those pupils have logged.
**Sessions** is how many class sessions have been run.
handbook.note: The line only appears once you have at least one class — there is nothing to total before that.
